absorb.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
absorb.text: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

acid-armor.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.
acid-armor.text: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

acid-spray.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
acid-spray.text: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

acrobatics.effect: Has double power if the user has no held item.
acrobatics.text: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.

acupressure.effect: Raises one of a friendly Pokémon’s stats at random by two stages.
acupressure.text: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.

aerial-ace.text: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

after-you.effect: Makes the target act next this turn.
after-you.text: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

agility.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
agility.text: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

air-cutter.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
air-cutter.text: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

air-slash.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
air-slash.text: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

alluring-voice.text: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

ally-switch.effect: User switches places with the friendly Pokémon opposite it.
ally-switch.text: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

amnesia.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by two stages.
amnesia.text: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

ancient-power.effect: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.
ancient-power.text: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also boost all the user's stats at once.

aqua-cutter.text: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

aqua-jet.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
aqua-jet.text: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

aqua-step.text: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

aqua-tail.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
aqua-tail.text: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

arm-thrust.text: The user attacks the target with open-palmed arm thrusts. This move hits two to five times in a row.

armor-cannon.text: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

assurance.effect: Power is doubled if the target has already received damage this turn.
assurance.text: This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.

astonish.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
astonish.text: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.

aura-sphere.text: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

avalanche.effect: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.
avalanche.text: This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.

axe-kick.text: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

baby-doll-eyes.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
baby-doll-eyes.text: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.

baton-pass.effect: Allows the trainer to switch out the user and pass effects along to its replacement.
baton-pass.text: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

beat-up.effect: Hits once for every conscious Pokémon the trainer has.
beat-up.text: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

belch.effect: Can only be used after the user has eaten a berry.
belch.text: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

belly-drum.effect: User pays half its max HP to max out its Attack.
belly-drum.text: The user maximizes its Attack stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.

bite.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
bite.text: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

bitter-blade.text: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

blast-burn.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
blast-burn.text: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can't move on the next turn.

blizzard.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
blizzard.text: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

block.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
block.text: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing.

body-press.effect: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.
body-press.text: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

body-slam.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
body-slam.text: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

boomburst.text: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.

bounce.effect: User bounces high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
bounce.text: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

brave-bird.effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
brave-bird.text: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

breaking-swipe.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
breaking-swipe.text: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

brick-break.text: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

brutal-swing.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
brutal-swing.text: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

bug-bite.effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
bug-bite.text: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

bug-buzz.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
bug-buzz.text: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

bulk-up.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
bulk-up.text: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

bulldoze.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
bulldoze.text: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

bullet-seed.text: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

burning-jealousy.effect: Burns the target if it had a state stage raise this turn.
burning-jealousy.text: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

calm-mind.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage.
calm-mind.text: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

charge.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage. User’s Electric moves have doubled power next turn.
charge.text: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

charge-beam.effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.
charge-beam.text: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.

charm.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.
charm.text: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

chilling-water.text: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

circle-throw.effect: Ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
circle-throw.text: The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

clear-smog.effect: Removes all of the target’s stat modifiers.
clear-smog.text: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.

close-combat.effect: Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
close-combat.text: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

coaching.effect: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
coaching.text: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

coil.effect: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.
coil.text: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

comeuppance.text: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

confuse-ray.text: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

confusion.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
confusion.text: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.

copycat.effect: Uses the target’s last used move.
copycat.text: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

cosmic-power.effect: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
cosmic-power.text: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to boost its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

counter.effect: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last physical hit it took.
counter.text: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.

covet.text: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.

crabhammer.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
crabhammer.text: The target is hammered with a large pincer. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

cross-chop.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
cross-chop.text: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

cross-poison.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.
cross-poison.text: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

crunch.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
crunch.text: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

curse.effect: Ghosts pay half their max HP to hurt the target every turn. Others decrease Speed but raise Attack and Defense.
curse.text: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.

dark-pulse.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
dark-pulse.text: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.

dazzling-gleam.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
dazzling-gleam.text: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

defense-curl.effect: Raises user’s Defense by one stage.
defense-curl.text: The user curls up and boosts its Defense stat.

destiny-bond.effect: If the user faints this turn, the target automatically will, too.
destiny-bond.text: If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

detect.effect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
detect.text: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

dig.effect: User digs underground, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
dig.text: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

disable.effect: Disables the target’s last used move for 1-8 turns.
disable.text: For four turns, the target will be unable to use whichever move it last used.

disarming-voice.text: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

discharge.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
discharge.text: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.

dive.effect: User dives underwater, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
dive.text: The user dives on the first turn, then floats up and attacks on the next turn.

doodle.text: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

double-edge.effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
double-edge.text: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

double-hit.text: The user slams the target with a tail or the like. The target is hit twice in a row.

double-kick.text: The user attacks by kicking the target twice in a row using two feet.

double-shock.text: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.

double-team.effect: Raises the user’s evasion by one stage.
double-team.text: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.

draco-meteor.effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
draco-meteor.text: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

dragon-breath.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
dragon-breath.text: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

dragon-cheer.text: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

dragon-claw.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
dragon-claw.text: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.

dragon-dance.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage.
dragon-dance.text: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

dragon-pulse.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
dragon-pulse.text: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

dragon-rush.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
dragon-rush.text: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.

dragon-tail.effect: Ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
dragon-tail.text: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

drain-punch.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
drain-punch.text: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

draining-kiss.effect: Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.
draining-kiss.text: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.

drill-peck.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
drill-peck.text: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.

drill-run.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
drill-run.text: The user crashes into the target while rotating its body like a drill. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

dual-wingbeat.text: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

earth-power.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
earth-power.text: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

earthquake.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.
earthquake.text: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

echoed-voice.effect: Power increases by 100% for each consecutive use by any friendly Pokémon, to a maximum of 200.
echoed-voice.text: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, its power is boosted.

eerie-impulse.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.
eerie-impulse.text: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

electric-terrain.effect: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power.
electric-terrain.text: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

electro-ball.effect: Power is higher when the user has greater Speed than the target, up to a maximum of 150.
electro-ball.text: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

electro-shot.text: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

electroweb.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
electroweb.text: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.

ember.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
ember.text: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

encore.effect: Forces the target to repeat its last used move every turn for 2 to 6 turns.
encore.text: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

endeavor.effect: Lowers the target’s HP to equal the user’s.
endeavor.text: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.

endure.effect: Prevents the user’s HP from lowering below 1 this turn.
endure.text: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

energy-ball.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
energy-ball.text: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

entrainment.effect: Copies the user’s ability onto the target.
entrainment.text: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.

expanding-force.effect: If Psychic Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power incrased by 50%.
expanding-force.text: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

explosion.text: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

extrasensory.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
extrasensory.text: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.

facade.effect: Power doubles if user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.
facade.text: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

fairy-wind.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
fairy-wind.text: The user attacks by stirring up a fairy wind to strike the target.

fake-out.effect: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle. Causes the target to flinch.
fake-out.text: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

fake-tears.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
fake-tears.text: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

false-swipe.effect: Cannot lower the target’s HP below 1.
false-swipe.text: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

feather-dance.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.
feather-dance.text: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

feint.text: This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.

fickle-beam.text: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.

fillet-away.text: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.

final-gambit.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s remaining HP. User faints.
final-gambit.text: The user risks everything to attack the target. The user faints but inflicts damage equal to its own HP.

fire-blast.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
fire-blast.text: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

fire-fang.effect: Has a chance to burn the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
fire-fang.text: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.

fire-pledge.effect: With Water Pledge, doubles the effect chance of friendly Pokémon’s moves for four turns.
fire-pledge.text: A column of fire hits the target. When used with its grass counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a vast sea of fire appears.

fire-punch.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
fire-punch.text: The target is attacked with a fiery punch. This may also leave the target with a burn.

fire-spin.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
fire-spin.text: The user traps the target inside a fierce vortex of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

first-impression.effect: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle.
first-impression.text: Although this move has great power, it works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

fissure.text: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

flail.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has less HP remaining, with a maximum of 200 power.
flail.text: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.

flame-charge.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Speed by one stage.
flame-charge.text: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.

flamethrower.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
flamethrower.text: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

flare-blitz.effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target.
flare-blitz.text: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot and may leave the target with a burn.

flash-cannon.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
flash-cannon.text: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

flatter.effect: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage and confuses the target.
flatter.text: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also boosts the target's Sp. Atk stat.

fling.effect: Throws held item at the target; power depends on the item.
fling.text: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

flip-turn.effect: User must switch out after attacking.
flip-turn.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

flower-trick.text: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

fly.effect: User flies high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
fly.text: The user flies up into the sky on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

focus-blast.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
focus-blast.text: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

focus-energy.effect: Increases the user’s chance to score a critical hit.
focus-energy.text: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that its future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits.

focus-punch.effect: If the user takes damage before attacking, the attack is canceled.
focus-punch.text: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.

follow-me.effect: Redirects the target’s single-target effects to the user for this turn.
follow-me.text: The user draws attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user.

foul-play.effect: Calculates damage with the target’s attacking stat.
foul-play.text: The user turns the target's strength against it. The higher the target's Attack stat, the greater the damage this move inflicts.

frenzy-plant.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
frenzy-plant.text: The user slams the target with the roots of an enormous tree. The user can't move on the next turn.

fury-attack.text: The user attacks by jabbing the target with a horn, a beak, or the like. This move hits two to five times in a row.

fury-cutter.effect: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, maxing out after five turns.
fury-cutter.text: The user attacks by slashing the target with scythes, claws, or the like. This attack becomes more powerful if it hits in succession.

fury-swipes.text: The user attacks by raking the target with claws, scythes, or the like. This move hits two to five times in a row.

future-sight.effect: Hits the target two turns later.
future-sight.text: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

gastro-acid.effect: Nullifies target’s ability until it leaves battle.
gastro-acid.text: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target's Ability.

giga-drain.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
giga-drain.text: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

giga-impact.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
giga-impact.text: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

gigaton-hammer.text: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.

glare.text: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

grass-knot.effect: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.
grass-knot.text: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

grass-pledge.effect: With Fire Pledge, damages opposing Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP every turn for four turns.
grass-pledge.text: A column of grass hits the target. When used with its water counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a vast swamp appears.

grassy-glide.effect: If Grassy Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its priority increased by 1.
grassy-glide.text: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

grassy-terrain.effect: For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 max HP each turn and strengthens their Grass moves to 1.5× their power.
grassy-terrain.text: The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.

gravity.effect: Disables moves and immunities that involve flying or levitating for five turns.
gravity.text: Enables Flying types or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves for five turns. Moves that involve flying can't be used.

growl.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
growl.text: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

growth.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.
growth.text: The user's body grows all at once, boosting the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

guard-swap.effect: User swaps Defense and Special Defense changes with the target.
guard-swap.text: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.

guillotine.text: A vicious tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

gunk-shot.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
gunk-shot.text: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.

gyro-ball.effect: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.
gyro-ball.text: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

hammer-arm.effect: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.
hammer-arm.text: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.

hard-press.text: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

harden.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.
harden.text: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to boost its Defense stat.

haze.effect: Resets all Pokémon’s stats, accuracy, and evasion.
haze.text: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

headbutt.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
headbutt.text: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. This may also make the target flinch.

heat-crash.effect: Power is higher when the user weighs more than the target, up to a maximum of 120.
heat-crash.text: The user slams into the target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.

heat-wave.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
heat-wave.text: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave them with a burn.

heavy-slam.effect: Power is higher when the user weighs more than the target, up to a maximum of 120.
heavy-slam.text: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.

helping-hand.effect: Ally’s next move inflicts half more damage.
helping-hand.text: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

hex.effect: Has double power if the target has a major status ailment.
hex.text: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.

high-horsepower.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
high-horsepower.text: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

hone-claws.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and accuracy by one stage.
hone-claws.text: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

howl.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
howl.text: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.

hurricane.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
hurricane.text: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind. This may also confuse the target.

hydro-cannon.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
hydro-cannon.text: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user can't move on the next turn.

hydro-pump.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
hydro-pump.text: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

hyper-beam.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
hyper-beam.text: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

hyper-drill.text: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

hyper-voice.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
hyper-voice.text: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.

hypnosis.text: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.

ice-beam.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
ice-beam.text: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

ice-fang.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
ice-fang.text: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

ice-hammer.effect: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.
ice-hammer.text: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.

ice-punch.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
ice-punch.text: The target is attacked with an icy punch. This may also leave the target frozen.

ice-shard.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
ice-shard.text: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

ice-spinner.text: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

icicle-crash.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
icicle-crash.text: The user attacks by crashing large icicles onto the target. This may also make the target flinch.

icicle-spear.text: The user attacks by launching sharp icicles at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

icy-wind.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
icy-wind.text: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.

imprison.effect: Prevents the target from using any moves that the user also knows.
imprison.text: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

incinerate.text: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.

infestation.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
infestation.text: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.

ingrain.effect: Prevents the user from leaving battle. User regains 1/16 of its max HP every turn.
ingrain.text: The user lays roots that restore its own HP every turn. Because the user is now rooted, it can't switch out.

iron-defense.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.
iron-defense.text: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

iron-head.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
iron-head.text: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

iron-tail.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
iron-tail.text: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

jaw-lock.effect: Prevents you and the target from switching out.
jaw-lock.text: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.

jet-punch.text: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

knock-off.text: The user slaps down the target's held item, making it unusable for that battle. This move does more damage if the target has a held item.

kowtow-cleave.text: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

lash-out.effect: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.
lash-out.text: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.

last-resort.effect: Can only be used after all of the user’s other moves have been used.
last-resort.text: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

last-respects.text: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.

lava-plume.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
lava-plume.text: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.

leaf-storm.effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
leaf-storm.text: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

leafage.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
leafage.text: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

leech-life.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
leech-life.text: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

leech-seed.effect: Seeds the target, stealing HP from it every turn.
leech-seed.text: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

leer.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.
leer.text: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stats.

lick.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
lick.text: The user licks the target with a long tongue to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

life-dew.effect: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
life-dew.text: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

light-screen.effect: Reduces damage from special attacks by 50% for five turns.
light-screen.text: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.

liquidation.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
liquidation.text: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

low-kick.effect: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.
low-kick.text: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

low-sweep.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
low-sweep.text: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.

lumina-crash.text: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

lunge.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
lunge.text: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

mach-punch.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
mach-punch.text: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

magical-leaf.text: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

magnet-rise.effect: User is immune to Ground moves and effects for five turns.
magnet-rise.text: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

make-it-rain.text: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.

matcha-gotcha.text: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

mean-look.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
mean-look.text: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

mega-drain.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
mega-drain.text: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

mega-kick.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
mega-kick.text: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

megahorn.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
megahorn.text: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

memento.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages. User faints.
memento.text: The user faints. In return, the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.

metal-burst.effect: Strikes back at the last Pokémon to hit the user this turn with 1.5× the damage.
metal-burst.text: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

metal-claw.effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack by one stage.
metal-claw.text: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also boost the user's Attack stat.

metal-sound.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
metal-sound.text: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

meteor-beam.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Raises the users Special Attack by 1 stage after the first turn.
meteor-beam.text: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

metronome.effect: Randomly selects and uses any move in the game.
metronome.text: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

mimic.effect: Copies the target’s last used move.
mimic.text: The user copies the move last used by the target. The copied move can be used until the user of Mimic leaves the battle.

mirror-coat.effect: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last special hit it took.
mirror-coat.text: A retaliatory attack that counters any special move, inflicting double the damage taken.

mist.effect: Protects the user’s stats from being changed by enemy moves.
mist.text: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.

misty-terrain.effect: For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion, and halves the power of incoming Dragon moves.
misty-terrain.text: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.

mortal-spin.text: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

mud-shot.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
mud-shot.text: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

mud-slap.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
mud-slap.text: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

muddy-water.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
muddy-water.text: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

mystical-fire.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
mystical-fire.text: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

nasty-plot.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.
nasty-plot.text: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

night-shade.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.
night-shade.text: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

night-slash.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
night-slash.text: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

noble-roar.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.
noble-roar.text: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

nuzzle.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
nuzzle.text: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

order-up.text: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.

outrage.effect: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
outrage.text: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

overheat.effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
overheat.text: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

pain-split.effect: Sets the user’s and targets’s HP to the average of their current HP.
pain-split.text: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally splits the combined HP between the target and itself.

parabolic-charge.effect: Heals the user for half the total damage dealt to all targets.
parabolic-charge.text: The user attacks everything around it. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by those hit.

parting-shot.effect: Lowers all targets’ Attack and Special Attack by one stage. Makes the user switch out.
parting-shot.text: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

payback.effect: Power is doubled if the target has already moved this turn.
payback.text: The user stores power, then attacks. This move's power is doubled if the user moves after the target.

peck.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
peck.text: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn to inflict damage.

petal-blizzard.text: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and damages everything around it.

petal-dance.effect: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
petal-dance.text: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

phantom-force.effect: User vanishes, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn. Hits through Protect and Detect.
phantom-force.text: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

play-rough.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.
play-rough.text: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

pluck.effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
pluck.text: The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

poison-fang.effect: Has a chance to badly poison the target.
poison-fang.text: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

poison-gas.text: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the faces of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those it hits.

poison-jab.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
poison-jab.text: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

poison-powder.text: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.

poison-sting.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
poison-sting.text: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

poison-tail.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.
poison-tail.text: The user hits the target with its tail. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also poison the target.

pollen-puff.effect: Damages opponents, but heals allies for 50% of their max HP.
pollen-puff.text: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

poltergeist.effect: Fails if the target has no held item.
poltergeist.text: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.

population-bomb.text: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.

pounce.text: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

pound.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
pound.text: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.

powder-snow.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
powder-snow.text: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also leave opposing Pokémon frozen.

power-gem.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
power-gem.text: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

power-swap.effect: User swaps Attack and Special Attack changes with the target.
power-swap.text: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.

power-trip.effect: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.
power-trip.text: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

power-whip.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
power-whip.text: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to lash the target.

protect.effect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
protect.text: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

psybeam.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
psybeam.text: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.

psych-up.effect: Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s.
psych-up.text: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

psychic.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
psychic.text: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

psychic-fangs.text: The user attacks by biting the target with its psychic capabilities. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

psychic-noise.text: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

psychic-terrain.effect: Protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and increases the power of their Psychic moves by 50%.
psychic-terrain.text: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

psycho-cut.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
psycho-cut.text: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

psyshock.effect: Inflicts damage based on the target’s Defense, not Special Defense.
psyshock.text: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

quash.effect: Makes the target act last this turn.
quash.text: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

quick-attack.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
quick-attack.text: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

quick-guard.effect: Prevents any priority moves from hitting friendly Pokémon this turn.
quick-guard.text: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.

rage-fist.text: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.

rage-powder.effect: Redirects the target’s single-target effects to the user for this turn.
rage-powder.text: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opposing Pokémon aim only at the user.

raging-bull.text: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

rain-dance.effect: Changes the weather to rain for five turns.
rain-dance.text: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

rapid-spin.effect: Frees the user from binding moves, removes Leech Seed, and blows away Spikes.
rapid-spin.text: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

razor-leaf.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
razor-leaf.text: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

recover.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.
recover.text: The user regenerates its cells, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.

recycle.effect: User recovers the item it last used up.
recycle.text: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

reflect.effect: Reduces damage from physical attacks by half.
reflect.text: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.

reflect-type.text: The user reflects the target's type to become the same type as the target.

rest.effect: User sleeps for two turns, completely healing itself.
rest.text: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

retaliate.effect: Has double power if a friendly Pokémon fainted last turn.
retaliate.text: The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move's power is boosted if an ally fainted in the previous turn.

reversal.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has less HP remaining, with a maximum of 200 power.
reversal.text: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

revival-blessing.text: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.

roar.effect: Immediately ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
roar.text: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

rock-blast.text: The user attacks by hurling hard rocks at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

rock-polish.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
rock-polish.text: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user's Speed stat.

rock-slide.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
rock-slide.text: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

rock-smash.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
rock-smash.text: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

rock-throw.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
rock-throw.text: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to inflict damage.

rock-tomb.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
rock-tomb.text: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.

rollout.effect: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, resetting after five turns.
rollout.text: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. This attack becomes more powerful each time it hits.

roost.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.
roost.text: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.

round.effect: Has double power if it’s used more than once per turn.
round.text: The user attacks the target with a song. If others use this move, they will act immediately after the initial user, and the power of their Rounds will be boosted.

safeguard.effect: Protects the user’s field from major status ailments and confusion for five turns.
safeguard.text: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

salt-cure.text: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.

sand-attack.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.
sand-attack.text: Sand is hurled in the target's face, lowering the target's accuracy.

sand-tomb.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
sand-tomb.text: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

sandstorm.effect: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns.
sandstorm.text: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to damage all Pokémon except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types.

scald.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
scald.text: The user attacks by shooting boiling hot water at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

scale-shot.effect: Boosts the user’s Speed and lowers their Defense by one stage after inflicting damage two to five times in a row.
scale-shot.text: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

scary-face.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
scary-face.text: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

scorching-sands.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
scorching-sands.text: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

scratch.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
scratch.text: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

screech.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.
screech.text: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target's Defense stat.

seed-bomb.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
seed-bomb.text: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

seismic-toss.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.
seismic-toss.text: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

self-destruct.text: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

shadow-ball.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
shadow-ball.text: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

shadow-claw.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
shadow-claw.text: The user attacks by slashing the target with a sharp claw made from shadows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

shadow-punch.text: The user throws a punch from the shadows. This attack never misses.

shadow-sneak.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
shadow-sneak.text: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

shed-tail.text: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

shift-gear.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage and its Speed by two stages.
shift-gear.text: The user rotates its gears, boosting its Attack stat and sharply boosting its Speed stat.

silk-trap.text: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.

sing.text: A soothing lullaby is sung in a beautiful voice that puts the target to sleep.

skill-swap.text: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

skitter-smack.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
skitter-smack.text: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

sky-attack.effect: User charges for one turn before attacking. Has a chance to make the target flinch.
sky-attack.text: The user attacks the turn after using this move. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also make the target flinch.

slack-off.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.
slack-off.text: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.

slam.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
slam.text: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

slash.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
slash.text: The target is attacked with a slash of claws, scythes, or the like. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

sleep-talk.effect: Randomly uses one of the user’s other three moves. Only works if the user is sleeping.
sleep-talk.text: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

sludge.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
sludge.text: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

sludge-bomb.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
sludge-bomb.text: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

sludge-wave.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
sludge-wave.text: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those it hits.

smack-down.effect: Removes any immunity to Ground damage.
smack-down.text: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. If the target is in the air, it will be knocked down to the ground.

smart-strike.text: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

smog.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
smog.text: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This may also poison the target.

snarl.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
snarl.text: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

snowscape.text: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

soak.effect: Changes the target’s type to Water.
soak.text: The user shoots a torrent of water that changes the target's type to Water.

solar-beam.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
solar-beam.text: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

solar-blade.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
solar-blade.text: The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light's energy and attacks on the next turn.

spark.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
spark.text: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

speed-swap.effect: Exchanges the user’s Speed with the target’s.
speed-swap.text: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

spicy-extract.text: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.

spikes.effect: Scatters Spikes, hurting opposing Pokémon that switch in.
spikes.text: The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

spiky-shield.effect: Blocks damaging attacks and damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP.
spiky-shield.text: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker that makes direct contact.

spin-out.text: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.

spit-up.effect: Power is 100 times the amount of energy Stockpiled.
spit-up.text: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move's power.

spite.effect: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4.
spite.text: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

splash.text: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

spore.text: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

stealth-rock.effect: Causes damage when opposing Pokémon switch in.
stealth-rock.text: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

steel-beam.effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up.
steel-beam.text: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

sticky-web.effect: Covers the opposing field, lowering opponents’ Speed by one stage upon switching in.
sticky-web.text: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching into battle.

stockpile.effect: Stores energy up to three times for use with Spit Up and Swallow.
stockpile.text: The user stores power and boosts its Defense and Sp. Def stats. This move can be used up to three times.

stomp.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
stomp.text: The user attacks by stomping on the target with a big foot. This may also make the target flinch.

stomping-tantrum.effect: Has double power if the user’s last move failed.
stomping-tantrum.text: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

stone-edge.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
stone-edge.text: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

stored-power.effect: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.
stored-power.text: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

strength-sap.effect: Heals the user by the target’s current Attack stat and lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
strength-sap.text: The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. It then lowers the target's Attack stat.

string-shot.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
string-shot.text: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.

struggle-bug.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
struggle-bug.text: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.

stuff-cheeks.effect: User consumes berry and raises its defense by 2 stages.
stuff-cheeks.text: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.

stun-spore.text: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

substitute.effect: Transfers 1/4 of the user’s max HP into a doll, protecting the user from further damage or status changes until it breaks.
substitute.text: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

sucker-punch.effect: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.
sucker-punch.text: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

sunny-day.effect: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.
sunny-day.text: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

super-fang.effect: Inflicts damage equal to half the target’s HP.
super-fang.text: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.

supercell-slam.text: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

superpower.effect: Lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
superpower.text: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.

supersonic.text: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

surf.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.
surf.text: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

swagger.effect: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages and confuses the target.
swagger.text: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.

swallow.effect: Recovers 1/4 HP after one Stockpile, 1/2 HP after two Stockpiles, or full HP after three Stockpiles.
swallow.text: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more power is stored, the more HP is restored.

sweet-kiss.text: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

sweet-scent.effect: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.
sweet-scent.text: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.

swift.text: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

switcheroo.text: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

swords-dance.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.
swords-dance.text: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.

synthesis.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP. Affected by weather.
synthesis.text: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

syrup-bomb.text: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.

tackle.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
tackle.text: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

tail-whip.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.
tail-whip.text: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Defense stats.

tailwind.effect: For three turns, friendly Pokémon have doubled Speed.
tailwind.text: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.

take-down.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
take-down.text: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

taunt.effect: For the next few turns, the target can only use damaging moves.
taunt.text: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

temper-flare.text: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

tera-blast.text: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

terrain-pulse.effect: If any terrain is active and the user is grounded, this moves power is doubled and changes type to match that terrains type.
terrain-pulse.text: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.

thief.text: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.

thrash.effect: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
thrash.text: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

throat-chop.effect: Prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
throat-chop.text: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.

thunder.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunder.text: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunder-fang.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
thunder-fang.text: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

thunder-punch.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunder-punch.text: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunder-shock.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunder-shock.text: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunder-wave.text: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

thunderbolt.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunderbolt.text: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

tickle.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
tickle.text: The user tickles the target into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defense stats.

tidy-up.text: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.

torch-song.text: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

torment.effect: Prevents the target from using the same move twice in a row.
torment.text: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

toxic.effect: Badly poisons the target, inflicting more damage every turn.
toxic.text: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

toxic-spikes.effect: Scatters poisoned spikes, poisoning opposing Pokémon that switch in.
toxic-spikes.text: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

trailblaze.text: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

trick.text: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.

trick-room.effect: For five turns, slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon.
trick-room.text: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

triple-axel.effect: Hits three times, increasing power by 100% with each successful hit.
triple-axel.text: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

triple-dive.text: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.

twin-beam.text: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

u-turn.effect: User must switch out after attacking.
u-turn.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

upper-hand.text: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

uproar.effect: Forced to use this move for several turns. Pokémon cannot fall asleep in that time.
uproar.text: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

vacuum-wave.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
vacuum-wave.text: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

venoshock.effect: Inflicts double damage if the target is Poisoned.
venoshock.text: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

volt-switch.effect: User must switch out after attacking.
volt-switch.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

water-gun.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
water-gun.text: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

water-pledge.effect: With Grass Pledge, halves opposing Pokémon’s Speed for four turns.
water-pledge.text: A column of water hits the target. When used with its fire counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a rainbow appears.

water-pulse.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
water-pulse.text: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

waterfall.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
waterfall.text: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

wave-crash.text: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

weather-ball.effect: If there be weather, this move has doubled power and the weather’s type.
weather-ball.text: This move's type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.

whirlpool.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle and inflicts 1/16 its max HP in damage for 2-5 turns.
whirlpool.text: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

whirlwind.effect: Immediately ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
whirlwind.text: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

wide-guard.effect: Prevents any multi-target moves from hitting friendly Pokémon this turn.
wide-guard.text: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.

wild-charge.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
wild-charge.text: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

will-o-wisp.text: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

wing-attack.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
wing-attack.text: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

wish.effect: User will recover half its max HP at the end of the next turn.
wish.text: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.

withdraw.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.
withdraw.text: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.

work-up.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.
work-up.text: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.

worry-seed.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.
worry-seed.text: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.

wrap.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
wrap.text: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

x-scissor.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
x-scissor.text: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.

yawn.effect: Target sleeps at the end of the next turn.
yawn.text: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

zap-cannon.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
zap-cannon.text: The user attacks by firing an electric blast like a cannon. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

zen-headbutt.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
zen-headbutt.text: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.
